notes.title: v0.13.0 Upgrades are carried over to the next episode. Also new music.
notes.content:
New:
- Weapons and Fabricator upgrades are carried over to the next episode.
- New music.
- Fixed switching weapons with gamepad and on Steam Deck.
- Some other minor improvements and fixes.

notes.title: v0.12.0 Foam Gun and some visual improvements
notes.content:
New:
- Foam Gun let the player to make barriers with a special weaponized anti-alien foam. Also this foam can engulf hostile enemies and slowly dissolve them.
- Juicier bullet penetration.
- Bullets kicks back targets during a hit.
- Other minor changes.

notes.title: v0.11.0 New Level Up system
notes.content:
New:
- Now the player can manually choose which item to Level Up.
- Some improvements for the enemy pathfinding.
- "Skills" menu renamed to "Fabricator" menu.
- New Seeker Mine is available in Fabricator menu.
- Other minor changes.

notes.title: v0.10.0 Military robots in boxes along the way and some visual improvements
notes.content:
New:
- Military robots in boxes along the way can help the player to fight Alien invaders.
- Some weird Alien grass. Or moss. Or something. Attracted to the player for some reason.
- Other minor visual changes.

notes.title: v0.9.0 Some weird Alien plants emit some weird dark energy
notes.content:
New weird alien plants:
- Clusters of small weird alien plants around some big weird alien plants.
- Touching the plant can hurt a little. The small ones explode immediately if you touch them.
- Big weird alien plants emit some weird dark energy field around. It doesn't hurt, but looks unpleasant and dark. It's better to get rid of that darkness. Just in case.

notes.title: v0.8.0 New weapon, new Skill, Dash movement, Alien Spiker and other improvements
notes.content:
New:
- Multiple weapons with new Automatic Rifle weapon.
- New Stunner Skill to disable Alien enemies around.
- Dash movement.
- New Alien Spiker plant attacks everyone around with Spikes when disturbed.
- Enemies now highlighted when they are behind a cover.
- More explosive barrels.
- The player character now always face the direction of the aim.
- UI animations.
- Skill description in the Skills menu.
- Some useful and not very useful objects fall from a tree when a tree is being shot.
- Other minor visual changes.

notes.title: v0.7.0 New Secondary attack and new Alien Bomber enemy
notes.content:
- Zap attack removed from Skills and can be used as a secondary attack for the gun. No Gears required for Zap attack anymore.
- New enemy type Alien Bomber. It drops Alien bombs.
- Dead enemies leave stains on a surface.
- Stylized grass.

notes.title: v0.6.0 Alien eggs all over the city and faster enemies
notes.content:
Alien eggs all over the city:
- Clear your path by destroying some alien eggs blocking your way.
- Destroy alien eggs to find some useful gears and medkits.
- Some alien eggs contain alien larva. Which can be used to extract a health pellet.

Enemies now move faster.

notes.title: v0.5.4 New Skills and swarms of angry alien insects
notes.content:
New Skills:
- Mine (blow up enemies in proximity of the mine);
- Zap (electric charge zap enemies close to the player character).

Destroy alien nests to release swarm of angry alien insects. Alien insect swarms attack both player character and enemies.

notes.title: v0.5.0 Skills gameplay mechanics, alien landing pods and other improvements
notes.content:
New gameplay mechanics and other changes:
- Use Skills to build Drone and Turret.
- Aliens now use landing pods to drop their troops behind the "front line".
- Squash alien larva to improve your health.
- Cars remain as an obstacle and do not disappear after being blown up.
- Some minor visual changes.

notes.title: 0.4.0 Collect Alien Cores to Level Up character's weapons and abilities
notes.content:
New game mechanics:
- Collect Alien Cores to Level Up character's weapons and abilities.

notes.title: v0.3.1 Xbox controller support and some visual improvements
notes.content:
This version of the game have Xbox controller support.

Also some visual improvements:
- New stylized fire
- New stylized explosions
- Wind VFX
- More dust near Alien Dusters
- New stylized trees
- Camera shake for explosions
